title: RU-RAD-6: Roman Urdu radicalization-related discourse markers (labels, annotation records, model outputs and code)
description: Labels-only release of the RU-RAD-6 resource: 1,520 Roman Urdu social-media posts annotated for six discourse markers, with the frozen train/validation/test partition, annotation guidelines, per-annotator sheets and adjudication records without post text, prompts, model outputs, per-post scores, analysis results and code. Post text is not redistributed; it can be reconstructed from the public source datasets RUHSOLD and RU-HSD-30K with code/rehydrate.py, subject to their terms. The labels describe textual expressions and must not be used to profile individuals, infer intent or support enforcement.
